scope: Explicit full-acceptance closure of active work-package rows in the current Lead and Member backlog tables; not thesis completion, effort, value, or evidence-quality percentage.

method.numerator: Rows explicitly documented as meeting their complete active-table acceptance criteria.
method.denominator: All active package IDs in the current Lead or Member table.
method.partial_work: Counted as not closed; no fractional credit is assigned.
method.overlap: Lead and Member rows can cover overlapping work. The pooled row ratio is descriptive only and is not an independent or effort-weighted overall score.

lead.qualification: L13′ closes a scope edit only, not scientific L13. L37 closes only its fixed-benchmark interval subdeliverable, not L38 or the full v4 case/pool work.

member.qualification: Some packages have substantial partial artifacts (including M-B, M-D, and M-I), but their active table acceptance remains unmet; partial progress is not scored as completion.

pooled_rows.qualification: Do not report this pooled ratio as thesis progress: package overlap, unequal effort, dependencies, and different acceptance scopes make that interpretation invalid.

not_scored: Overall academic_vision_and_strategy completion: no defensible exhaustive denominator is defined.
Midterm/endterm target attainment: milestones have not been mapped to this package-closure denominator.
Partial completion: no fractional package weights or complete subdeliverable ledger was used.

source_files.note: Research checkout is dirty and has no configured remote; this is a local inspected source snapshot, not a clean shared revision.

verification.evidence_ceiling: Documented closure states in backlog text only; not a fresh audit of every underlying scientific artifact or result.
